basic_profile.bio: I'm a high school freshman interested in engineering and building things. I live in a suburban area in the Midwest, USA. I'm into making things with my hands, especially cool engineering projects like trebuchets. I spend most of my online time after school, usually from 5 PM to 10 PM. Besides school, I play around with my MicroFreak synthesizer and I'm trying to learn Polish. I'm single and looking to make more friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm currently in high school and taking an introductory engineering class. I've learned a lot about basic physics and mechanics through this class. I also self-teach myself music production with the MicroFreak synthesizer, and I'm exploring language learning through online resources.
